question.title: Should the fix touch the generated schema file?
question.body: internal/store/schemas/build.ok.json is produced by go generate from the BuildResponse type; the lint failure the review flagged lives inside it, and a hand edit would be overwritten on the next generate.
question.recommended: Skip it: fix the source type instead and regenerate, in a follow-up commit.

zing.progress: Reviewed every changed file except the generated one.
